sample_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you had to make a decision that wasn't popular but was right for the customer.
Describe a situation where you took on something significant outside your area of responsibility.
Give me an example of when you simplified a complex process or system.
Tell me about a time when you had to deliver results despite significant obstacles.
Describe a situation where you disagreed with a decision and how you handled it.
